newsitem.title: CANADA: Wajax to buy Pacific North Equipment.
newsitem.headline: Wajax to buy Pacific North Equipment.

text.p: Wajax Ltd said on Monday it signed an agreement to acquire 100 percent of the shares of the Pacific North Equipment Co from Matthew Norton Co, a Seattle-based investment holding company.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The acquisition is expected to close at the end of February, Wajax said.

Pacific North distributes and sevices the Komatsu, Dresser, Timberjack and other product-lines in the United States, including Washington, Oregon and Alaska. Its annual sales are in the range of US$85-90 million, Wajax said.
